      (H : Subgroup.{u} G) →
        CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{max u_1 u, max u_1 u, max u ((max u_1 u) + 1), max (u + 1) ((max u_1 u) + 1)}
          (Rep.indFunctor.{max u_1 u, u, u, u} k (Subgroup.subtype.{u} H))
          (Rep.resFunctor.{max u_1 u, u, u, u} (Subgroup.subtype.{u} H))

(k G : Type u) →
  [inst : Field.{u} k] →
    [inst_1 : Group.{u} G] →
      (H : Subgroup.{u} G) →
        (W : Rep.{max u_1 u, u, u} k (Subtype.{u + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u, u} H x)) →
          (V : Rep.{max u_1 u, u, u} k G) →
            LinearEquiv.{u, u, max u_1 u, max u u_1} (RingHom.id.{u} k)
              (Quiver.Hom.{max u_1 u, max (u + 1) ((max u_1 u) + 1)}
                (Rep.ind.{max u_1 u, u, u, u} (Subgroup.subtype.{u} H) W) V)
              (Quiver.Hom.{max u u_1, max u ((max u_1 u) + 1)} W
                (Rep.res.{u, u, u, max u_1 u} (Subgroup.subtype.{u} H) V))
